div.head: Af El. 24
div.ab: Gif hwa forstele oþres oxan ⁊ hine ofslea oððe bebicge, sylle twegen wið ⁊ feower sceap wyþ anum. Gif he nite hwæt he sylle, sy he sylf beboht wið þan feo.
Gif hwa forstele oðres oxan ⁊ hine ófslea oððe bebycgge, selle twegen wið ⁊ feower sceap wið anum. Gif he næbbe hwæt he selle, sie he self beboht wið ðam fio.
Si quis furatus fuerit ouem aut bouem et occiderit uel uendiderit, quinque boues pro uno boue restituet et quatuor oues pro una oue.
Gif hwa forstele oðres oxan ⁊ hine ofslea oððe bebycgge, selle twegen wið ⁊ feower sceap wið anum. Gif he næbbe hwæt he selle, sie he self beboht wið ðam fio.

If someone should steal another’s ox and slay him or sell him, let him give two for it and four [sheep] for one. If he does not have what he should give, let him be sold himself in exchange for the livestock.

Wenn einer den Ochsen eines anderen stiehlt und ihn schlachtet oder verkauft, gebe er zwei dagegen und vier Schafe gegen ein [gestohlenes]. Wenn er nicht, was er hergeben könne, besitzt, werde er selbst [als Ersatz] für das Vieh verkauft.

If someone steals another’s ox and slaughters or sells it, let him give two in return, and four sheep for one [stolen]. If he does not possess what he could give, let him himself be sold [in compensation] for the livestock.
